# Painted Porch Strategies

> Organizational shift strategy and change origination for leaders ready to architect extraordinary outcomes.

Painted Porch Strategies partners with organizations at the moment of strategic authorship—before decisions are made and before initiatives are scoped. The site offers strategic assessments, workshops, courses, and ongoing partnership programs built around Phase Zero preparation, the P.A.T.H. methodology, and The Painted Porch Pillars framework.

## Pages

- [/](/): Home — explore the three-track ecosystem and partnership tiers.
- [/about](/about): About Painted Porch Strategies and the team.

- [/about/impact](/about/impact): Client stories, charity work, and organizational impact.
